stand-block.note: Pitch side at the bottom. Seats are light grey: tint the tile (or draw it twice, masked) for club-coloured seats. Variants: full (baked heads), empty, construction.

led-board-frame.note: Transparent screen rectangle; draw the ad text behind/inside it.

floodlight-tower.note: Top-down, lamps face the pitch (down). Rotate per corner.

tunnel.note: Mouth at the bottom (pitch side). Canopy light grey: tint with the club colour.

bench.note: Seats and floor; bench-roof is the translucent roof drawn over the people.
